description: This file provides utility functions for formatting currency amounts, specifically USD, with dynamic precision and optional credits suffix. It ensures consistent display of currency values across the application, handling various edge cases and formatting preferences.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a currency string with optional credits suffix, handling dynamic decimal precision based on the value's magnitude.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText
methods.description: Convenience function to format USD amounts with credits appended, defaulting to including credits.

methods.name: formatUsdUpToSixDecimals
methods.description: Formats a USD amount with up to six decimal places and thousands separators.
